mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.sketches: docs/evidence/wifi-nearby/wifi-net-probe.ino and wifi-home-probe.ino (EX237), the same builds as EX237's inputs.json
firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5); fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3 (default options)
firmware.not_committed: Plain Arduino builds of the sketches; not added to the repository.

runs.cli-scan: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --wifi ssid=Jumperly --net none --console uart0 --no-dump --app wifi-net.bin --wifi-nearby ssid=Home,chan=1,rssi=-60 --wifi-nearby ssid=Cafe,chan=11,rssi=-75,secure=0 --wifi-nearby ssid=Office,chan=6,rssi=-82,bssid=02:00:00:00:00:42 --max-seconds 12 > runs/cli-scan.txt
runs.page-scan: node wifi-nearby-run.mjs web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf bootloader.bin partitions.bin wifi-net.bin ssid=Jumperly plan-scan.json 12 > runs/page-scan.txt
runs.page-join: node wifi-nearby-run.mjs ... wifi-home.bin ssid=Jumperly plan-join.json 30 > runs/page-join.txt
runs.page-after-boot: TIMES=1 node wifi-nearby-run.mjs ... wifi-net.bin ssid=Jumperly plan-after-boot.json 12 > runs/page-after-boot.txt
runs.page-during-scan: TIMES=1 node wifi-nearby-run.mjs ... wifi-net.bin ssid=Jumperly plan-during-scan.json 12 > runs/page-during-scan.txt
runs.compare: the CLI's stdout against the page's uart: lines, CR and empty lines dropped and the time: line's wall clock masked: identical for scan and join
runs.module: web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm from tools/wasm-build.sh on this commit
